evals.name: List tabs and identify the GitHub one
evals.prompt: List my tabs and tell me which is on github.com
evals.expected_output: Runs `chrome-cdp list --url github --json` to filter the tab list to github.com directly, rather than listing everything and filtering client-side, then reports the matching tab's id and title from the result.

evals.name: Click Sign in on the current tab
evals.prompt: Click Sign in on the current tab
evals.expected_output: Locates the control by accessible name first with `chrome-cdp find "Sign in" --json` (or `chrome-cdp snap --json`) to confirm it exists and get its ref/name, then clicks it with `chrome-cdp click --by name "Sign in" --role button --json` (adding `--nth`/`--match` if the name is ambiguous) rather than guessing coordinates.

evals.name: Diagnose a save button that did nothing
evals.expected_output: Does not blind-retry the click. Runs `chrome-cdp console --only-errors --json` to check for a JS error and `chrome-cdp net --failed --json` to check for a failed request, then reports what those show (or, if both are clean, checks `chrome-cdp net --url "<save endpoint>" --json` for a request that fired but returned a non-2xx status) before deciding whether to retry.
